content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving a vast majority of creators without access to its services. PayPal, while more widespread, has a notorious reputation for account suspensions that can freeze funds for up to 180 days, without the possibility of appeal. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also exhibit similar geographical restrictions, effectively barring creators in multiple regions from selling their digital products. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH's offerings provides the foundational tools necessary for creators to establish their own independent online stores, allowing them to bypass these limitations entirely.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms often exclude entire countries based on regulatory environments, risk assessments, or market potential. This exclusion directly impacts creators who want to sell plugins or other digital products. For example, Stripe's absence in key markets means creators in those regions cannot accept payments through its platform. PayPal's restrictive policies lead to uncertainty and instability, while other services may simply block access altogether. The sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a structural alternative by empowering creators with tools to set up their own systems, ensuring they have full control over their sales and revenue streams, regardless of their geographic location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed is a critical factor for digital creators. Conventional platforms like PayPal can delay fund availability due to their account verification processes and potential suspensions. Stripe's fees can also eat into profits, especially for smaller transactions. In contrast, using a sovereign stack with NOWPayments allows creators to process payments in real-time with only a 0.5% fee, providing a clear, predictable cost structure. Furthermore, with recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, transaction fees are often under $0.10, making it economically viable for creators to sell their products without sacrificing profits.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you back in control of your digital store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the stark differences between conventional platforms and a sovereign commerce solution is the level of ownership and control. Platforms like PayPal and Stripe maintain access to your funds and data, creating a dependency that can be detrimental. In contrast, when using COREMERCH's infrastructure, creators retain complete ownership of their digital stores, products, and customer data post-deployment. This ownership is coupled with automation capabilities that streamline payment processing and product delivery, ensuring that creators can focus on their content rather than getting bogged down in administrative tasks.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture is crucial for effectively reaching your target audience. If you're in a restricted region and need a quick solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a great entry point, providing basic infrastructure for immediate deployment. For those requiring more robust features and scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack offers advanced capabilities and support for up to five products. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit is your all-in-one solution, including everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can still sell digital products using a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach enables you to set up your own online store without the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors, giving you full control over your sales. By using tools like NOWPayments and Google Cloud services, you can effectively process payments in cryptocurrency.
No more account suspensions or fund holds; your money is yours.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting the right stack from COREMERCH, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Set up a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your online store. Configure NOWPayments for automated crypto payment processing. Use tools like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, and Google Drive for file storage. Finally, deploy your store and begin selling your digital products while retaining full ownership.
